question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Occlude
solution:
The correct answer is '**Obstruct**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Occlude**' is '**Obstruct**'.
 
• **Occlude**: stop, close up, or obstruct (an opening, orifice, or passage). [बंद करो, बंद करो, या बाधा (एक उद्घाटन, छिद्र, या मार्ग)।]
 
 
• *Example: Thick make-up can **occlude** the pores.*
 
 
 
• **Obstruct**: to stop something from happening or somebody/something from moving either by accident or deliberately. [किसी के काम में अड़चन डालना या रुकावट पैदा करना (अनजाने में या जानबूझ कर)]
 
 
• *Example: Could you move on, please? You’re **obstructing** the traffic if you park there.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Obstruct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Facilitate**: to make something possible or easier. (किसी बात को संभव या आसान बनाना)
 
• **Promote**: to encourage something; to help something to happen or develop. (किसी बात को प्रोत्‍साहित करना; किसी बात के होने या बढ़ने में सहायता करना)
 
• **Abstain**: to stop yourself from doing something that you enjoy. (अपने को संयम में रखना; परहेज़ करना)
